facts.text: I decided to upgrade my road bike's pedals to clipless pedals today.
I upgraded my road bike's pedals to Shimano Ultegra clipless pedals.
I am thinking of scheduling a maintenance check for my road bike at a local bike shop.
I am concerned that the brakes on my road bike feel a bit spongy lately.
I want the mechanic to check the brake pads for wear and contamination during the maintenance check.
I want the mechanic to give me an estimate for replacing the brake pads if needed.
I want the mechanic to check the chain and gears for wear during the maintenance check.
I want the mechanic to give me an estimate for replacing the chain if it is worn out.
I have been noticing skipping and hesitation when shifting gears lately.
I want the mechanic to check the tire pressure and make necessary adjustments during the maintenance check.
I want my tires properly inflated for the new clipless pedals.
I want the mechanic to check the quick releases and bolts on my bike to make sure they are tightened properly.
I have heard that loose quick releases can be a safety hazard.
I want to make sure everything is secure before I start riding with my new clipless pedals.
